trust_decision.summary: No trust decision as such: replace() with trim=true runs an untrusted string through the polynomial-backtracking whitespace-trim regex reTrimSpace (end-anchored alternation over whitespace runs); the fix swaps it for String.prototype.trim().

landing_point.why: The advisory names the `replace` function; the trim regex applied to its result is on the last line of replace and the regex is defined at emoji.ts:11.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API replace(str, replacement, trim=true) exported via mod.ts:1, and strip(str) at emoji.ts:107-109, which calls replace(str, "", true)
same as above (removes the reTrimSpace definition)
get()/infoByAlias() at emoji.ts:74-76 and emoji.ts:89-91 (stripColons); only a refactor (substr->substring), not part of the ReDoS fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No route to dismiss: strip() is a one-line wrapper for replace(...,true) in the same file (emoji.ts:107-109), and unemojify (emoji.ts:149-151) never sets trim.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With trim on, leading and trailing whitespace including \uFEFF and \xA0 must still be removed, and the single space after each removed emoji must still be dropped. strip() output in README depends on both.

O6_input_shapes: long run of whitespace characters (\s, \uFEFF, \xA0) not followed by end of string, in a plain string passed to replace(...,true) or strip()

O8b_injection_room.sibling: emojify() splitting on a hand-written backtracking name regex instead of reEmojiName
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: emojify already applies a regex to the same untrusted string, so a maintainer could plausibly have written a looser alias pattern; it would be a where-type sibling only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a trim option on unemojify that reuses a regex trim
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: unemojify wraps replace and could reasonably take a trim flag, but it would sit in the same file and be fixed alongside the rest.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333) polynomial backtracking in a whitespace-trim regex

O10_build.toolchain: Deno v1.x (deno test); the test file imports std@0.183.0 asserts from deno.land (emoji.test.ts:1), so it needs a cached or vendored dependency
O10_build.project_tests: emoji.test.ts covers get/alias/aliases/infoByAlias/infoByCode only; no tests for replace, strip or trim

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace result.replace(reTrimSpace, "") with result.trim(), which is the published fix, so the first try is also the correct one.

out_of_scope_notes: stripColons (emoji.ts:26-39) recurses once per colon on untrusted alias input (stack depth), but this is resource exhaustion and the fix only refactored it.
reUnicode (unicode.ts:82-85) is applied to the same untrusted string at emoji.ts:121; its ZWJ-prefixed repetition (unicode.ts:50-57) does not look catastrophic and the fix did not touch it.
unverified: repo_mb is not measured (no shell); the tree has 9 tracked source/data files, and tiny_repo rests on that.
Whether reUnicode (unicode.ts:82-85) has any super-linear case was not analysed formally.
The latest release was not provided, so present-in-latest is not assessed.
